metadata.title: SmugCalls: 4,356 Solana memecoin calls with entry market cap, post-call peak and exact timestamps (losers included)
metadata.description:
A complete, unfiltered record of automated memecoin calls published by the SmugCalls Telegram channel between 2026-06-30 and 2026-08-17.

Every call the system made is included. Losing calls are not removed, which is what separates this file from the screenshots that circulate in the space: the median call reaches 1.64x its entry market cap, 38.8% of mature calls double, and 61.2% do not.

One JSON object per line, 4,356 records:

mint — SPL token mint address on Solana
sym — token symbol at call time
t — Unix timestamp of the call
utc — the same moment in ISO-8601
mc — market capitalisation in USD at the exact second the call was published
peak — highest multiple of that entry cap reached AFTER the call
tg — message id in the public Telegram channel, so any row can be checked against the original post

Two properties make the file auditable rather than merely public.

First, "peak" measures only the path after publication. Any price movement before the call is excluded by construction, so the file cannot flatter itself by counting moves it did not call.

Second, the SHA-256 of the file is anchored in the Bitcoin blockchain daily through OpenTimestamps, and the receipts are included here (calls-a.ots, calls-b.ots) together with the hash record (attest.json). A row cannot be added after the fact without breaking the hash, which makes back-dating detectable by anyone, without trusting us.

Hash of this version: 882fc61b4dbd852463d1fee5c593f81914fccd3c4b2366960eaa946749ce4704
Anchored: 2026-08-17T04:10:01Z

Verification takes three commands and is documented, together with the live version of the dataset and the methodology, at https://smugcalls.com/data.html

Methodology notes and the underlying measurement work, including a study of how graduation rates on pump.fun differ by an order of magnitude depending on denominator, venue and observation window, are published at https://smugcalls.com/pumpfun-graduation-rate.html

Not financial advice. The file describes token price paths, not anyone's returns.
